summary_en: Framework update on capital cost and stock price-conscious management. Board approved further updates to existing disclosures on current analysis, policy, and initiatives as of 31 July 2026, building on prior updates disclosed 10 July 2026.
title_en: Update on Measures to Realize Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, the board of Atrae, Inc. (6194, TSE Prime) approved an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management framework. The company has been disclosing analysis, policy, and specific initiatives on this topic through earnings briefing materials. A prior update was announced on 10 July 2026. The current disclosure communicates a further evolution of that framework. Detailed specifications are contained in the attached materials (not reproduced in the first two pages provided).
